stories.title: Who Are the Israeli Hostages Released by Hamas?
stories.summary: Hamas released four Israeli soldiers, all women, from the Gaza Strip. They were the second group freed under a fragile ceasefire agreement, as Israelis awaited their return.

stories.title: Suspected Sabotage of Deep-Sea Cable Triggers First NATO-Led Response
stories.summary: NATO mounted its first coordinated response to a suspected campaign of sabotage against critical infrastructure. The action followed the severing of another deep-sea cable in the Baltic Sea.
